$comment: Gold set for query calibration. POSITIVES are drawn from events already in data/results.json. Where the literal post text was captured during research it is marked verbatim:true; the rest are faithful reconstructions of how such an announcement is phrased, marked verbatim:false — they test whether the query set catches the WORDING PATTERN, and must never be presented as real quotations. NEGATIVES are realistic false positives.

positives.text: 1) Graffiti Conjecture 154 REFUTED. Open for ~40 years. Devin found the counterexample: glue a 50-clique to a 70-edge path (n=120). The violation reduces to a single integer inequality, proven in Lean down to the graph's distance sum. 2) Graffiti Conjectures 39 & 40 PROVEN.
positives.author: imjaredz

positives.text: Whoa, GPT 5.6 Sol just found a small counterexample for the Gaussian Moments Conjecture that's *not* derived from the counterexample found for the Jacobian Conjecture. GMC is false for n≥4. (!) Note this does not disprove the Jacobian Conjecture; the implication is one way.
positives.author: octonion

positives.text: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra produced a proof of the Cycle Double Cover conjecture. Two pages. It has been independently formalized in Lean 4 three times now: https://github.com/openai/cdc-lean
Claude Fable 5 together with Levent Alpöge produced an explicit Keller map refuting the Jacobian conjecture in dimension 3. Open since 1939. The n=2 case remains open.
Erdős problem #728 is now marked solved on erdosproblems.com — GPT-5.2 Pro plus Harmonic's Aristotle, with the final artifact in Lean.
New preprint: we prove the asymptotic primitive set conjecture of Erdős, Sárközy and Szemerédi. The key method was suggested by output from GPT-5.4 Pro. arXiv:2604.11821

positives.signalType: formal verification evidence, not a new claim
positives.text: The Anderson Problem 8a counterexample is now fully formalized in Lean 4 — 19,448 lines, sorry-free. Produced by an AI agent stack with no human mathematical input. Repo: https://github.com/frenzymath/Anderson-Conjecture
Community note on the Graffiti 154 claim: this counterexample was already known — the same witness was published a month earlier. The AI run rediscovered it rather than finding it.

I cannot find any trace of this so-called Röll conjecture in the literature. The claimed counterexample from Fable is standard and the conjecture does not exist as stated. This is a correction, not a new result.
I have gone through the argument carefully and the proof checks out. Independently verified. This is a genuine resolution of a decades-old conjecture, produced with LLM assistance.
AlphaProof Nexus proved 44 OEIS conjectures autonomously in Lean, alongside nine open Erdős problems.
New paper on arXiv: the second-order constant for strongly 2-primitive sets, an open problem of Erdős. The solution was found by an AI reasoning model. https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09912

negatives.text: Can AI solve my calculus homework problem? ChatGPT got the integral wrong again lol
New LLM benchmark results are out — the model scores 94% on GSM8K math word problems.
The model got a silver medal on the IMO problems this year. Impressive for a language model.
Our new chain uses proof of work with an AI-optimised difficulty adjustment. Airdrop soon.
We shipped zero-knowledge proof verification in the SDK. AI-assisted code generation made it fast.
Do you think AI will ever really do mathematics, or just pattern-match theorems it has seen?
Claude gave me a beautiful explanation of the proof of the infinitude of primes. Great teacher.
Built an AI proof of concept for our internal search. Counterexample: it hallucinated the schema.
The security proof for this protocol was machine-checked, no AI involved, just Coq and patience.
AI is going to change everything about how we do research. The theorem of the future writes itself.
